stories.title: Mold Carnival returns to Maes Bodlonfa Fields on Sunday 5 July with free entry
stories.summary: Mold Carnival returns to Maes Bodlonfa Fields on Sunday 5 July, with free entry and a programme running from 11am to 6pm. stories.title: Chester Haematology Centre to open at Countess of Chester Hospital in late July
stories.summary: A new dedicated centre for blood cancer patients is due to open at the Countess of Chester Hospital in late July, with north Wales patients among those who will use it. stories.title: Welsh skills rising among Flintshire council staff as annual language report published
stories.summary: The share of Flintshire County Council staff who say they have no Welsh skills has fallen from 33.1 per cent to 28.7 per cent in a year, according to the council’s annual Welsh language report.
